name: @onlyvisioncode/browser-mcp

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL

tools.name: browser_go_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page

tools.name: browser_go_forward
tools.description: Go forward to the next page

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page. Use this for getting references to elements to interact with.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Perform click on a web page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over element on page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into editable element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

text.description: Text to type into the element

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select an option in a dropdown

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

ref.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a key on the keyboard

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait for a specified time in seconds

time.description: The time to wait in seconds

tools.name: browser_get_console_logs
tools.description: Get the console logs from the browser

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current page

tools.name: browser_get_console_errors
tools.description: Get console errors and exceptions from the browser

tools.name: browser_get_network_logs
tools.description: Get network requests and responses from the browser

tools.name: browser_get_network_errors
tools.description: Get network errors and failed requests from the browser

tools.name: browser_run_performance_audit
tools.description: Run a performance audit on the current page

tools.name: browser_run_seo_audit
tools.description: Run an SEO audit on the current page

tools.name: browser_run_nextjs_audit
tools.description: Run a Next.js specific audit on the current page

tools.name: browser_run_debugger_mode
tools.description: Run debugger mode to debug an issue in the application

tools.name: browser_run_audit_mode
tools.description: Run audit mode to optimize the application for SEO, accessibility and performance

tools.name: browser_run_best_practices_audit
tools.description: Run a best practices audit on the current page

tools.name: browser_get_selected_element
tools.description: Get the selected element from the browser DevTools

tools.name: browser_wipe_logs
tools.description: Wipe all browser logs from memory

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the current browser tab
